stories.title: GPU Render Hook Type Definitions
stories.story: As a plugin author, I want typed GPU render hook interfaces, so that I can register post-processing shaders with full IDE support.
acceptance: ResttyGPURenderHook type exported with shaderGLSL, shaderWGSL, animated fields
ResttyGPURenderHookOptions type exported with priority and paneId
ResttyGPURenderState type exported with all Ghostty-compatible fields
ResttyPluginContext type includes addGPURenderHook method signature
ResttyPluginInfo includes gpuRenderHooks count
ResttyPluginRuntimeDisposerKind includes 'gpu-render-hook'
All new types exported from src/index.ts
RESTTY_PLUGIN_API_VERSION bumped to 2

files.changes: Add types, extend PluginContext, extend PluginInfo, extend DisposerKind

stories.title: Post-Processing Shader Sources
stories.story: As the renderer, I need fullscreen quad shaders and Ghostty uniform wrappers for both WebGPU and WebGL2, so that user mainImage() functions can be executed as post-processing passes.
acceptance: WGSL fullscreen quad vertex shader (outputs position + v_uv)
WGSL post-process fragment wrapper with Ghostty uniform struct
GLSL 300 ES post-process vertex shader
GLSL 300 ES post-process fragment wrapper with all Ghostty uniforms as individual uniforms
Both wrappers call mainImage(fragColor, fragCoord) following Ghostty convention
User shader source is concatenated into the wrapper before compilation
Passthrough shader available as fallback (samples iChannel0 unmodified)

stories.title: Post-Process Pipeline Infrastructure
stories.story: As the renderer, I need to manage intermediate textures and post-processing pipelines, so that the terminal frame can be captured as iChannel0 and processed by plugin shaders.
acceptance: WebGPUPostProcessState type with: intermediateTexture, intermediateView, sampler, pipeline, bindGroup, uniformBuffer
WebGLPostProcessState type with: fbo, colorTexture, program, uniformLocations, vao
createWebGPUPostProcess(device, format, width, height, shaderSource) function
createWebGLPostProcess(gl, width, height, shaderSource) function
destroyWebGPUPostProcess(state) cleanup function
destroyWebGLPostProcess(state) cleanup function
resizeWebGPUPostProcess(state, width, height) recreates texture
resizeWebGLPostProcess(state, width, height) recreates FBO texture
updateGhosttyUniformsWebGPU(device, buffer, state: GhosttyUniformState) writes std140 buffer
updateGhosttyUniformsWebGL(gl, program, state: GhosttyUniformState) sets individual uniforms
GhosttyUniformState type covering all scene/cursor/focus/color uniforms
Shader compilation errors caught and reported gracefully

stories.title: Plugin API: addGPURenderHook on ResttyPluginContext
stories.story: As a plugin author, I want to call ctx.addGPURenderHook() during activation, so that my shader is compiled and registered for post-processing.
acceptance: addGPURenderHook(hook, options?) method on ResttyPluginContext
Returns ResttyPluginDisposable with dispose() for cleanup
GPU hooks stored in gpuRenderHooks[] array on Restty class
Priority-sorted like other interceptors
Hook registration triggers shader compilation via callback to renderer
Hook disposal triggers pipeline teardown
First hook registration triggers intermediate texture allocation
Last hook disposal triggers texture deallocation
pluginInfo() reports gpuRenderHooks count
attachRuntimeDisposer tracks 'gpu-render-hook' kind
Callback mechanism from Restty class to per-pane renderer closures

files.changes: Add gpuRenderHooks array, addGPURenderHook, context wiring, disposal, diagnostics

stories.title: Two-Pass Render Integration (tickWebGPU + tickWebGL)
stories.story: As the renderer, I want to conditionally switch between single-pass and two-pass mode based on active GPU hooks, so that post-processing shaders run without affecting the default path.
acceptance: tickWebGPU: when GPU hooks active, Pass 1 renders to intermediateTexture instead of swapchain
tickWebGPU: Pass 2 draws fullscreen quad with plugin shader to swapchain
tickWebGPU: when NO GPU hooks, code path is IDENTICAL to upstream (single pass)
tickWebGL: same conditional FBO-based two-pass approach
Ghostty uniform buffer populated per frame with: iTime, iResolution, iFrame, iTimeDelta, iFrameRate
Cursor tracking: iPreviousCursor updated when cursor moves, iTimeCursorChange timestamped
Focus tracking: iFocus set via document focus/blur, iTimeFocus timestamped
Color uniforms: iBackgroundColor, iForegroundColor, iCursorColor from theme/WASM state
iCurrentCursor computed from cursor.col * cellW, cursor.row * cellH, cellW, cellH
needsRender forced true when animated GPU hooks are active (continuous rendering)
Canvas resize recreates intermediate texture via existing updateSize/resizeState
Performance: single additional fullscreen quad draw call when enabled

files.changes: Conditional two-pass in tickWebGPU (~lines 5867-6036), tickWebGL, cursor tracking, focus tracking, resize hook, uniform population

stories.title: Build Verification + Test Plugin
stories.story: As a developer, I want to verify the implementation compiles and works with a real shader plugin, so that I can confirm the feature is functional before submitting a PR.
acceptance: npm run build / tsc passes with zero errors
Example CRT plugin activates via restty.use() and renders scanlines + barrel distortion
Example cursor trail plugin activates and shows animated trail between cursor positions
Disposing plugins reverts to clean single-pass rendering
No regressions in existing functionality (terminal renders correctly without plugins)

phases.name: Type Definitions
phases.description: Add all TypeScript types for the GPU render hook plugin API. No runtime code changes.

phases.name: Shader Sources
phases.description: Write the WGSL and GLSL wrapper shaders that host user mainImage() functions.

phases.name: Renderer Infrastructure
phases.description: Create/destroy/resize intermediate textures and post-process pipelines for both WebGPU and WebGL2.

phases.name: Plugin API Wiring
phases.description: Wire addGPURenderHook into the Restty plugin system with registration, disposal, and diagnostics.

phases.name: Render Integration
phases.description: The core change: modify tickWebGPU and tickWebGL for conditional two-pass rendering with per-frame Ghostty uniform population.

phases.name: Verification
phases.description: Build, test with real shader plugins, verify no regressions.

parallelizable.note: Types and shaders can be written simultaneously
Renderer infra and plugin API wiring can overlap after types are done
